editorial:
Imagine hanging out with your best friends and suddenly finding yourself caught up in a deadly crime. You get pulled into a wild ride where four buddies decide to hide a killing to protect each other. The vibe starts off like a normal friend group hangout, but it quickly turns into a tense game of cat and mouse. You will feel the stress as these characters stop trusting one another, wondering if their closest pals are actually lying to their faces. It is a fun, twisty setup that keeps you guessing about who is actually the bad guy in the group.

The acting feels real, and the plot moves quickly so you never get bored. While some of the plot twists might feel a bit wild, the suspense makes up for it. If you love stories where people turn on each other, you should definitely give this a shot.
endingExplained: The big twist reveals that the entire crime was a setup. One of the friends had been manipulating the others from the start to cover their own tracks. In the final scenes, the lies fall apart and the real killer is finally exposed. The movie ends with a shocking turn of events where the person you least expect takes the fall, proving that secrets always come out in the end.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves twisty mysteries and dark comedies.
